endings.text:
You broadcast the pattern on every band Meridian can reach. Within a year, eleven more crash fields answer. The signal was never a message to one listener — it was a roll call, and humanity just said [i]here[/i].

History will argue about whether you were brave or reckless. The sky, at least, is never quiet again.
endings.title: THE BROADCAST

endings.text:
The quarantine council meets for nine years. They catalog the phrase, the footage, the handshake. They publish nothing and learn everything.

When the council finally votes to answer, the signal has been waiting the whole time. Patient things usually win.
endings.title: THE LONG TABLE

endings.text:
You bury the fragments under Vesper's red dust and file the report that says nothing fell. Camp Halcyon's lanterns burn on schedule. Nobody ever knows.

Some nights your spectrometer hums four notes in your dreams. You never tell anyone. Some doors stay shut — but you always know exactly where they are.
endings.title: THE QUIET

endings.text:
You say yes. The rewrite is gentle: your memories keep their shape but gain a second edge, like a coin with two faces. You can read the sky now the way you used to read instruments.

Meridian lists you as lost on the Vesper dive. You are not lost. You are [i]elsewhere[/i], and elsewhere is larger than you were told.
endings.title: THE DIVERGENT
